## The task

The box starts at rest on the floor, the disk's centre 10 cm from the box's.
The box must end fully on the platform, at rest. The **indirect lift** tips
the box onto the step corner, lets the disk walk round to the box's raised
underside, lifts the box off the floor and rolls it onto the platform; the
box is held at every instant. Its formation sequence is

{g} → {m<sub>x</sub>, g} → {m<sub>x</sub>, g, s} ⇒ {m<sub>x</sub>,
g<sub>v</sub>, s<sub>v</sub>} → {g<sub>v</sub>, s<sub>v</sub>} →
{m<sub>z</sub>, g<sub>v</sub>, s<sub>v</sub>} → {m<sub>z</sub>,
s<sub>v</sub>} → {m<sub>z</sub>, t} → (transport) goal.

**The hint.** The search is given this sequence and nothing else: at a node
in the chain's k-th formation it may try only edits into the (k+1)-th, plus
transports inside the k-th. **The planner chooses** the transition poses
(the gate's sweep), the disk placements, the motions (the quasi-static
realizer Λ<sub>qs</sub> in MuJoCo), the transport targets and the order of
the calls. Finding the indirect lift *without* the hint is the open problem
([Issues](../planar-build/issues.qmd)).

## Result

| Disk friction μ | Solved | Calls | On the path | Box at the end | Search time |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 0.3 | **yes** | 16 | 12 | on the platform, x = 78 mm, 90° | 20 min |
| 0.4 | **yes** | 13 | 11 | on the platform, x = 74 mm, 90° | 13 min |
| 0.5 | **yes** | 17 | 12 | on the platform, x = 74 mm, 90° | 10 min |

Every call is Λ<sub>qs</sub>: no learned skill, no release. The route:

1. make(m<sub>x</sub>): the disk reaches the box's −x face; a push to the
   riser; make(s).
2. The pivot {m<sub>x</sub>, g, s} ⇒ {m<sub>x</sub>, g<sub>v</sub>,
   s<sub>v</sub>}: the box topples onto the step corner.
3. Pushes tilt the box: to 43° at μ = 0.3 and 0.5 (two pushes), to 20° at
   μ = 0.4 (one).
4. break(m<sub>x</sub>): the box turns on its two corners, to 63° (μ = 0.3,
   0.5) or 54° (μ = 0.4), and the disk lets go.
5. make(m<sub>z</sub>) on the raised underside, then break(g<sub>v</sub>):
   the box leaves the floor at 66°, 63° and 68.5°, held by the disk and the
   step corner.
6. The roll s<sub>v</sub> → t to 90°, onto the platform; two pushes to the
   goal.

Calls off the path are the search's other branches: at μ = 0.3 and 0.5 a
break(m<sub>x</sub>) from 20° reaches 50–52°, and break(g<sub>v</sub>)
from there fails *departure*; at μ = 0.4 a break(m<sub>x</sub>) from 44°
fails *persistence*.

## How to read a clip

- **View.** From the side, with +x to the **left**, as in the paper. The
  green surface is the platform, the grey one the floor, the blue ball the
  disk. A red stripe marks the face the box rests on at the start.
- **Top-left box.** μ, the run's options and commit; the current segment
  *k/n* with its edit and formations (σ → σ′); the formation the recognizer
  reads right now; and whether the replay matched the log.
- **Speed.** Stated in the overlay. Λ<sub>qs</sub> calls are about 21 s
  long and mostly at rest, so they play at 3× while the box rests and in
  real time while it moves.
- **Cards.** A short hold after each segment, then the success test's
  verdict.
:::

## What this shows, and what it does not

- **Held at every friction of the band.** The same planner, with the gate
  and the tracker at the band's lower end 0.3, lifts the box at μ = 0.3, 0.4
  and 0.5. The last four edits of this chain and its closing transport are
  also certified for every μ ∈ [0.3, 0.5]
  ([Certifying a whole box](../planar-build/certificate.qmd#the-indirect-lift)).
- **The hint.** The formation sequence is given. From the scene alone the
  search does not find this lift.
- **The realizer.** Λ<sub>qs</sub> plans a sequence of held poses, not a
  stick–slip plan. A stick–slip variant is built (option `stick_slip`, off):
  replaying 227 logged calls it realizes 9–12 fewer per μ than the default
  (with its transition search on), and its chain search fails at μ = 0.3 ([The local solver](../planar-build/local-solver.qmd#qs-slip)).

## Configuration and reproduction

Branch `phase1/planar` at commit `0da97ba`, run from `cmg/`. `CMG_DISK_FRICTION`
sets the simulator's μ; the gate and the tracker use 0.3; Λ<sub>qs</sub> runs
its default options, including the two path fixes `disk_path_fix` (the disk
moves evenly along the box's face) and `roll_press_fix` (the roll keeps
rotating about the step corner). The budget is 64 calls; each search runs in
one CPU process. Every run records Λ<sub>qs</sub>'s options in its output
(`qs_options` in `calls.json`). The searches and clips ran at commit
`f4cffd1`, where the two path fixes were options set on the command line
(`--qs disk_path_fix=True,roll_press_fix=True`); at `0da97ba` they are the
defaults, so the commands below need no option.

```text
CMG_DISK_FRICTION=0.3 CMG_MAPGUARD=50000 JAX_PLATFORMS=cpu PYTHONPATH=src \
    .venv314/bin/python scripts/step4/chain_search/run_chain.py OUT --budget 64
CMG_DISK_FRICTION=0.3 JAX_PLATFORMS=cpu PYTHONPATH=src \
    .venv314/bin/python scripts/step4/videos/render_d23.py OUT --ids F1-lift-s0-00000 --out VIDEO
```

Earlier runs, each with the configuration it was measured at, are on
[Earlier runs (archive)](archive.qmd).
